title: CPI Group Limited - proposed acquisition of Detagna Pty Ltd trading as Red Paper Group
industries: Distribution of fine paper including copy paper
targets: Detagana Pty Ltd trading as Red Paper Group

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines. Market inquiries commenced.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC requested further information from CPI. ACCC timeline suspended.
ACCC received further information from CPI. ACCC timeline recommenced.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: CPI Group Limited proposes to purchase the business and net tangible assets of Detagana Pty Limited which in Australia trades as Red Paper Group
body_sections.Market definition: The proposed acquisition was considered in the context of the national market for the supply of fine and copy paper by merchants (distributors).
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in the national market for the supply of fine and copy paper by merchants because of the following factors: - the ability of customers to switch to alternative fine and copy paper merchants; and - smaller fine and copy paper merchants appear likely to act as effective competitive constraint on the merged entity due to the relatively low barriers to expansion in the relevant market.
